↳ Posted by Atk on March 14th, 2012.

Neither……

“Atk” - the first tune in that set has been discussed here before. It’s “The Milky Way” - a composition of Vincent Broderick, posted here years ago. Strange that Aly Bain didn’t recognise it, as it was recorded by the “Boys Of The Lough” I would think over 30 years ago. However, the man plays so many tunes, he’s never going to be able to remember the names of them all. There are similarities right enough, but the first tune in that video is “The Milky Way” - not “Miss Monaghan”. Neither is it “The Boys Of 25”.

↳ Posted by Jon Antonsson on April 28th, 2021.

Miss Monaghan, X:12

This is some of what Matt Molloy is doing on the setting of Miss Monaghan on “Music At Matt Molloy’s.”
I think it’s one of the most exciting pieces of Irish flute playing I ever heard, mainly because he keeps bouncing of the low D and playing bars in the low octave, making full use of the flute dynamics.

I slowed it down and discovered quite a lot of variations including “gbfb edB z” which I never heard before here.
( though it does remind me of Maud Miller or Colemans Cross or something ? )

Bar 13 is one I made up myself for this. ( It’s not on the track )

Hope this is useful
Pat
